Paper_Title: Early prediction of sepsis in the ICU using machine learning
What_They_Did: Applied dynamic GBDT and temporal neural networks for sepsis prediction with SHAP interpretability.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX uses strict expanding past-only median/IQR normalization without future batch leak and dual-tier MAP policy.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: Moor et al. demonstrated 0.77-0.84 AUROC but experienced transportability drop externally.

Paper_Title: An Improved Multi-Output Gaussian Process RNN with Application to Sepsis Early Warning
What_They_Did: Modeled sparse physiological time series using Multi-Output Gaussian Processes coupled with RNN.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX uses lightweight tabular XGBoost/LightGBM with explicit dual-tier thresholding and past-only Z-score.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: Futoma showed high performance but computationally expensive MGP unsuitable for edge deployment.

Paper_Title: Early Prediction of Sepsis from Clinical Data: The PhysioNet/Computing in Cardiology Challenge 2019
What_They_Did: Established benchmark dataset and evaluation utility metric across 104 international algorithms.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX provides comprehensive forensic audit of observation-process transportability shift between Set A and Set B.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: Reyna et al. showed top teams suffered 10-20% Utility drop on unseen test set.

Paper_Title: Predicting sepsis onset using recurrent neural networks
What_They_Did: Evaluated LSTM RNNs on continuous ICU vital signs and laboratory parameters for early sepsis detection.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX introduces explicit MAP physiological gating (MAP < 75 or d3 < -3) coupled with 3-step persistence.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: LSTM achieved AUROC 0.81 but acted as a black box without operational alarm suppression policy.

Paper_Title: Prediction of Sepsis in the Intensive Care Unit With Minimal Data via InSight
What_They_Did: Demonstrated early sepsis detection using only 6 primary vital signs with gradient boosted trees.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX incorporates 122 features including 39 raw, 39 expanding Z, 39 deltas, and 5 derived clinical indices.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: InSight proved minimal vitals work but suffered high false alarm rates without confirmation gating.

Paper_Title: A targeted real-time early warning score (TREWScore) for septic shock
What_They_Did: Developed TREWScore identifying patients at high risk of septic shock prior to organ dysfunction.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX predicts S_next4 sepsis onset using GBDT with asymmetric dual-tier screening/confirmation policy.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: TREWScore established early warning feasibility but suffered low PPV (< 20%).

Paper_Title: Artificial intelligence in sepsis early warning and response systems
What_They_Did: Systematic review of 43 sepsis AI algorithms, concluding majority lack external validation and transportability.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX provides complete forensic accounting of missingness and measurement-density transportability decay.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: Goh et al. identified measurement process shift as top unaddressed barrier in clinical AI.

Paper_Title: Prospective validation of a machine learning sepsis early warning system
What_They_Did: Prospective validation of TREWS across 5 hospitals showing 18.7% reduction in sepsis mortality.
What_BioMarkerX_Does_Differently: BioMarkerX focuses on retrospective forensic analysis of measurement density shift between PhysioNet A and B.
Evidence_Difference_Matters: Adams et al. proved hierarchical alerting reduces clinician alarm fatigue in live deployment.
